g.title: repeat_invoice
g.text: Repeat invoice: JSON in, PDF out, once per period. No model in the loop.

g.title: w_due
g.text: ✓ month-end days, nothing before the day,
one per missed period, no remakes, end date, count

g.title: w_number
g.text: ✓ highest seen + 1, a number on disk is never reused

g.title: w_save
g.text: ✓ an existing file is never overwritten;
a failed render burns no number
